title: ATS Jobs Openings Scraper – Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Recruitee
description: Live jobs from Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Recruitee, Workable, SmartRecruiters and Workday in one schema, auto-detected from the slug. Top-level department plus team, not the nested cost-centre name. City/region/country from free text. Pay ranges, even in-posting ones. Filter before you pay.
seoTitle: Hiring Page Scraper, Hiring Data Feed, Pay Range Data
seoDescription: An ATS and applicant tracking system API: job openings data, employment data API, recruiting data API, recruitment data API, open roles API, hiring trends data, and jobs data feed exports.

job.eventDescription: One normalized job posting returned to the dataset.
